title: Batch 2 preview detectors: nine false findings of the JA templates stay gone, the real cases are still found, and Tracy Apple reads its own contract
steps: S1: Run each batch 2 detector probe in headless Chrome on the page shapes that gave a false finding (a heading on a background picture, a header over a hero that is not its ancestor, a footnav logo, an accordion row, .text-hide words, a role=img SVG, a clipped icon path, an outline button with a rotated ::before, a visually hidden legend) and on the real case next to each.
S2: Ask quickstartContractOf and quickstartTemplateOf for tracy-apple/j6.
S3: Check a release whose preview rows are older than the current probe, and a version with no measurement file.
expect: S1: no finding on any of the nine false shapes; the real case beside each is still one finding.
S2: joomla-tracy-base and joomla/tracy-base, never the Airbnb pack's contract.

S3: the older rows read 'not measured with the current preview probe' with both probes in the stamp, and the fix is the stand + flow + preview-check --write commands filled with the release's tag and version (preview only when only the preview is older).
evidence: Batch 2 measurement of 31 JA templates at probe v8 (16/10/2026), findings grouped and looked at by eye
fence: Detector probes, the contract lookup and the TDSR measured rules in tracy-web; no stand
